top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a single complete physiological chain (Holst on human incretin physiology, Drucker on proglucagon processing and GLP-1 receptor biology, Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) that has been independently reproduced for about three decades and validated in glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcome trials, so maturity is not in doubt. The three names map to three distinct steps within the three-laureate limit, and a citation worded around the physiology and active form avoids ruling on the Mojsov/Habener priority question. Leaving out Knudsen is a choice about discovery versus development, not a judgment of her importance. No award (P000) is ranked last because the attribution uncertainty is a reason to word the citation carefully, not a reason to withhold an achievement of this standing.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; co-authorship of the 2016 spatial-transcriptomics paper and eight co-authored works with Rickard Sandberg do not involve any credited name on B021
